# Luoc do kham pha nhu cau khach

Hoi ro doi tuong nguoi dung cuoi, khoi luong hoi thoai du kien, va tich hop CRM hien co.
Lam ro yeu cau tuan thu: luu tru log, phan quyen, va vung luu du lieu.
De xuat buoc tiep theo: demo, bao gia rut gon, hoac workshop kien truc neu deal lon.

# Goi gia va loi ich ban hang

Goi Starter phu hop doi nho can thu nghiem nhanh voi chi phi thap.
Goi Growth danh cho doanh nghiep can dashboard va nhieu nguoi dung hon.
Goi Enterprise co tich hop API, SSO va ho tro tuy chinh theo hop dong.
